title: FD | Cancellation coded UNCONTROLLABLE (WXX Weather) but controllability under determination / disputed ? MANUAL (No Determination) | APPR | Rebooked, arrived late (+7h) | 2 Pax | Single leg | Domestic (CA) | Basic Aeroplan (claimant)
description:
Checks that DDS doesn't automatically decline a weather cancellation while the coding is still being reviewed. Flight AC 305 YUL ? YVR is cancelled on the day of travel. Both passengers are rebooked on AC 311 and arrive 7 hours later than promised. The cancelled flight has cancellation code WXX (Weather, uncontrollable). It also carries an open coding review (code 00 / IU "Under Investigation"), so controllability is disputed. DDS returns NO DETERMINATION with CAD 0 for both passengers. It does not return Not Eligible (FD-APPR-NE-28) and does not decline in the chat. The chatbot shows the standard No Determination message and creates one case for both passengers, sent to manual review with a 30-day commitment. There is no CyberSource check, no Cash or AC Wallet offer, no IDV and no payment.

PNR: UD002 � 2 passengers: Marie-�ve Tremblay (Adult - Claimant, Basic Aeroplan 9876543210, good standing), Luc Tremblay (Adult). Promised (14-day itinerary): AC 305 YUL ? YVR, Aug 5, 2026, departing 08:00, arriving 10:30 local. Change: INVOL on Aug 5, AC 305 cancelled (customers told on the day). Actual: AC 311 YUL ? YVR, Aug 5, arriving 17:30 local, both boarded (coupons flown). Delay at arrival: 7h (420 min). AC 305 cancellation code: WXX (Weather). Coding status: under review, code 00 / IU "Under Investigation" also logged. No voluntary changes (VOL). AC only. Not a group booking. Claim filed Aug 14, 2026 (more than 72h, within 366 days). No duplicate. Not employee, not infant. Country of residence: Canada.
